text:
Maria: Quick alignment — moderator cheat-sheet + demo handoff for Wed (11am PT). We have a 6-min live demo slot. Need: concise opener, 60s context, 3-step demo script, and a clear fallback (recording + CLI) in case live model calls stall. Who can draft the script and the handoff lines?

Alex: I can draft the moderator script. Will keep the handoff <90s. Any constraints on live calls or allowed model variants?

Jamal: Prefer to avoid long-running live gen. Pre-warm caches and use a short prompt set. Plan: show latency delta (cold vs pre-warmed) and a quick cost note.

Eva: Ill prepare slides + a "demo failed" slide with a recorded clip. Uploading a 60s fallback video to Drive now.

Maria: Draft moderator script idea (very short):
- 0:00–0:20: Welcome + one-liner: why inference economics matters for product teams.
- 0:20–0:40: Context: demo will show how caching + batching cut latency and cost.
- 0:40–1:10: Handoff: "Jamal will show a live demo. Hell run two examples — first cold, then with caching. If anything goes wrong well play a recorded clip and summarize results."
- 1:10–end: Quick wrap: note where to find benchmark artifacts and cost calc.

Alex: Handoff lines Id use (3 short sentences):
"Up next is Jamal from Platform. Jamal, you have the stage — screen + mic. If live fails, please play the 60s recording on slide 5."

Jamal: Sounds good. Ill rehearse it twice later today. Can we do a 10-min dry run 30 mins before the event start to validate screen share and audio?

Eva: Yep — Ill schedule the preflight. Also pinned the recording to the backstage doc and the ops Slack channel. Link: https://drive.example.com/recording123 :thumbsup:

Maria: Demo fallback CLI (for ops) — one-liner to run the prerecorded demo locally:
```bash
# local fallback: serve pre-recorded demo on port 8080
docker run --rm -p 8080:8080 redwood/demo:canary --use-recording /data/recording.json
```

Ops Bot: Deploy update: demo container image redwood/demo:canary pushed at 1791112100 (sha256:abc123) — staging endpoint available at https://staging.demo.redwood.example

Alex: I'll add the short checklist to the moderator sheet: mic check, spotlight Jamal, share slide 5 on fallback, confirm recording playback works.

Jamal: Confirmed rehearsal slot: today 14:00 PT. Ill also prepare a 30s "narrative" line to tie demo to customer ROI.

Maria: Great — calendar invite and rehearsal link sent to panel + ops. @Eva please pin the drive link in the live ops doc and add a note about the CLI fallback.

Eva: Done — pinned and added the CLI snippet. Also uploaded the recording (recording123). Ill keep the backstage Slack thread unlocked during the event for last-minute cues.

Alex: LGTM. Anything else we need?

Maria: No, thanks everyone. Final run tomorrow morning 30m before show.

Jamal: Copy. Will be ready.

Eva: :white_check_mark:
